---
name: Bounded improvement
about: Propose a testable change and its limits
title: "[Proposal] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## User problem
Who needs this, and which current task fails?

## Proposed contract and boundaries
Inputs, outputs, sources and authority. Explain whether the change requires new data rights, credentials, schema changes or external actions.

## Validation before implementation
Synthetic examples, counterexamples, unchanged safety invariants, baseline and acceptance criteria. Separate unit checks, model evidence and real-system validation.

## Reuse and attribution
Dependencies, licenses, existing implementations, AI assistance and limitations. Do not invent production adoption or measured savings.
